title: Inter's papers went 4 for 14 this week — the scorecard #Shorts
description:
Inter's press made 14 reported claims this week. Four came true, none were denied, ten are still open.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=40

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Calhanoglu back in full training (Quotidiano Sportivo, Oct 5; Inter.it confirmed Oct 6, and he took Saturday's penalty)
CONFIRMED — Lautaro Martinez home from Argentina in time (TyC Sport, Oct 6; Sky Sport Italia, Oct 7; he played against Parma)
STILL OPEN — A 100 million euro valuation for Pio Esposito (Gazzetta dello Sport, Oct 8)
STILL OPEN — English interest in Petar Sucic, and a raise to discuss (Corriere dello Sport, Oct 8)
STILL OPEN — Anguissa, Kovacic and Bernabe on Baccin's desk (Tuttosport, Oct 6)
STILL OPEN — Three to four weeks out for Jones (Sky Sport Italia, Oct 8)
